name: Shadow Magic
summary: Sorcerers touched by the Shadowfell who wield darkness.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.short: Darkvision 120 ft.; cast Darkness with sorcery points.
features.summary: You have darkvision out to 120 ft. From 3rd level, you learn Darkness and can cast it by spending 2 sorcery points, seeing through it yourself.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.short: At 0 HP, a CHA save can leave you at 1 HP.
features.summary: When damage reduces you to 0 hit points (not radiant or a crit), you can make a CHA save (DC 5 + damage taken) to drop to 1 hit point instead. Once per long rest.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.short: Spend 3 sorcery points to summon a shadow hound against a foe.
features.summary: As a bonus action, spend 3 sorcery points to summon a hound of shadow that hunts one creature within 120 ft. The target has disadvantage on saves against your spells while the hound is within 5 ft. of it.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.short: Bonus action: teleport 120 ft. between shadows.
features.summary: While in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action you can teleport up to 120 ft. to another unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.short: Spend 6 sorcery points: resist most damage and move through objects.
features.summary: As a bonus action, spend 6 sorcery points to become shadowy for 1 minute: resistance to all damage except force and radiant, and you can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain.
